I can't rule out up, left, down or right yet, so I'll make an educated guess: up.

Going right leaves no safe move afterwards. So the line goes down.

Contradiction! Every way forward fails: going left, the next 5 moves are forced and the line gets stuck at number 3; going down, every way of continuing runs into a dead end within a few moves. So my guess (up from number 1) was wrong. Next I'll try left.

Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes up.
Cell (1,6) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes up.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes left.
Going left would cut off the top-left corner (4 cells). So the line goes down.
Going left would leave both cell (1,4) and cell (3,4) needing the line next, and it can't do both. So the line goes down.
Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes left.
Every cell is covered and the numbers are in order. Case closed!
